01 — HOW IT WORKS

From the first call to the keys.

1 · Brief
A 20-minute call
Budget, move-in date, neighbourhoods, who's moving, how your income reads to a Spanish landlord. We tell you what your budget buys today.
2 · File & applications
Spanish-format, in 24 hours
Payslips or contract, NIE or passport, references, bank statements, a presentation letter in Spanish. Then we apply within the hour of a listing going live.
3 · Viewing & contract
A BOOM person in the room
Live video walkthrough and a written report. Rent, deposit, guarantees and contract type checked against the LAU before you sign. Then keys and padrón.

03 — BEFORE YOU SIGN

Six things we check before you sign.

Six points we put in writing on every contract.

I
The depositfianza

One month by law. Extra guarantees are capped at two months' rent. Agents still ask for more. We don't let them.

II
Who pays the agentLey 12/2023

The landlord pays their own agent. That agent charging you a fee is a red flag. You hire us; we do not act for the landlord.

III
The rentno regional cap

No regional cap in Madrid: the asking price is the market. We say if it is out of line and read the update clause.

IV
Contract typeLAU

A habitual-residence lease protects you in ways a 'temporada' lease does not. We check which one you are handed, and which charges land on you.

V
Registrationpadrón · NIE

Registered at the town hall with your contract: health card and school place hang on it. We confirm it before you pay.

VI
Income rulesnómina · aval

Payslips, a bank guarantee, a Spanish guarantor: each landlord asks differently. New job, foreign salary, freelance — we write it so it passes.

04 — QUESTIONS

The questions we get asked.

Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain now?
Yes: the landlord bears their own agency costs. That rule covers the landlord's agent. You can still hire your own, who works only for you, and pay for that work. That is what we are, and we never take anything from landlords or their agents.
Which service is mine?
Full Search (€500) if you haven't started. Application Pack (€199) if you've found one and need to apply, or you have a shortlist and you're already in Madrid. Attended Viewing (€149 per viewing) if you have a shortlist and you're still abroad. Not sure: open a file, we advise.
How fast will I have an apartment?
Budget and move-in date decide it. A complete Spanish-format file and applications inside the hour are what shorten it. Nobody can promise a date in Madrid. Anyone who does is selling you something else.
Do I need to be in Madrid?
No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the padrón.
What if you don't find anything?
Then we talk. We say in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market, and we would rather decline a search than take one we don't believe in — if we decline, Full Search is refunded in full.
How do I pay?
By card on this page (Stripe) when you start, or by bank transfer against an invoice from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.
What do you do with my data?
It is used to answer you and to run your search, and for nothing else. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it and we will.
